long_biography.plain_text:
CTP's build-to-own model turned Remon Leonard Vos from a trader and factory operator into a major European industrial-property entrepreneur. A steel-parts venture in the Czech Republic needed modern premises, so Vos and his partners created a business park that could house their factory alongside other tenants. They kept developing around those occupiers instead of treating each building as a one-off sale.

Vos has kept development, construction and property management within CTP, allowing new buildings to follow tenant demand and remain under long-term ownership. As chief executive, he works without a fixed office, travelling between country teams to inspect sites, assess land and secure business. That operating habit keeps him directly involved in the choices that shape each market.
